signature.name: VTask.pi
signature.type: {R : Type uR} -> {ι : Type uι} -> {M₁ : ι → Type v₁} -> [Semiring R] -> [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M₁ i)] -> [(i : ι) → Module R (M₁ i)] -> {ι' : Type u_1} -> {M' : ι' → Type u_2} -> [(i : ι') → AddCommMonoid (M' i)] -> [(i : ι') → Module R (M' i)] -> (f : (i : ι') → MultilinearMap R M₁ (M' i)) -> MultilinearMap R M₁ ((i : ι') → M' i)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total and imposes no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for every valid family of multilinear maps, including the degenerate cases of empty index types.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (ι : Type*) (M₁ : ι → Type*) (ι' : Type*) (M' : ι' → Type*) [Semiring R] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M₁ i)] [∀ i, Module R (M₁ i)] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M' i)] [∀ i, Module R (M' i)] (f g : ∀ i : ι', MultilinearMap R M₁ (M' i)), VTask.pi f = VTask.pi g ↔ f = g
